description: AR AEB block offline, so no AEB icon is drawn. gate=ADAS fusion(0x4C1 6.2-6.3)=1, ONLINE_0x32D(0x32D 5.6)=0 forces all fcwData warning fields (Acute_Warning_S, AEB_State_S) to the offline default 0xFF, so the acute branch (acuteWaring_==0x1 && aebStates_==0x1) never matches and mAEBImage is not drawn.

can.desc: Acute_Warning_S: acute warning set but AEB block not online, value ignored
AEB_State_S: AEB active state set but AEB block not online, value ignored
ONLINE_0x32D_S: AEB/FCW block offline, fcwData set to offline default so warning suppressed
